payload.note: Exact disintegration proves that integrated-marginal and constrained zero-fiber Ward identities weight backgrounds by q_eta(0), whereas the annealed score target requires division by q_eta(0) under the constrained measure. On the certified fixed-6^4 BT runaway family, strict convexity, a unique mode below -m, and q_m{u>=-m}<=2^-m imply q_m(0)<=2^-m/m, so a background-uniform density lower bound and pointwise constrained-Ward transfer are obstructed as formulated. This does not obstruct an annealed theorem because those backgrounds may be Gibbs-rare. The active gate is a joint annealed tail estimate coupling center/score growth to inverse-density or background action cost, followed by the integrated marginal and H^-1 shell sum.
